d.en: You've been invited to a Halloween party! Yay! Music! Food! Drinks! Vampires! Wait. VAMPIRES!? Velvet Bite: Softly, With Teeth is a Romantic Visual Novel featuring 6 romanceable vampires.
d.zh:
你被邀请参加万圣节派对！好耶！ 
音乐！食物！饮料！吸血鬼！ 

等等。吸血鬼！？ 

 
一款包含6位可攻略吸血鬼角色的恋爱视觉小说。
